csv_project_name: DB Service Albert-Oakland Family Aquatic Center Improvements
csv_agency: City Of Columbia - Parks And Recreation
csv_scope_of_work: This document constitutes a request for proposals (RFP) for the design and construction of pool improvements at Albert-Oakland Aquatic Center in Columbia, Missouri (hereinafter referred to as the City). The City seeks an offeror employing highly qualified personnel with extensive experience and expertise in delivering work of the nature described herein and providing full-service design-build services. Contractor shall provide design and construction services for improvements to the Albert-Oakland Family Aquatic Center. The improvements shall include all updates to the mechanical equipment as well as structural issues.
